name: SWARM SIEGE
tagline: CO-OP LANE MAZE DEFENCE · ONE LANE EACH, UP TO 4
howto: EVERY PLAYER HOLDS A LANE. THEY ALL RUN INTO THE MIXER, THE GOLD SQUARE ROUND THE WATCHER, AND EVERY WAVE COMES DOWN EVERY OPEN LANE AT ONCE.
CLICK YOUR LANE OR THE MIXER AND YOUR PEPE WALKS OVER AND PUTS DOWN A FIREWALL (5 GOLD). THE SWARM TAKES THE SHORTEST WAY ROUND WHATEVER IS BUILT, SO MAKE IT A LONG ONE. YOU CAN'T WALL IT IN.

CLICK A FIREWALL TO TURN IT INTO A TOWER: LASER NODE, COLD WALLET (SLOWS), AIRDROP (BURSTS, GROUND ONLY), GAS SPIKE (CHAIN LIGHTNING, IGNORES ARMOUR), ORACLE (SEES INVISIBLE, HITS FLYERS HARD) OR VALIDATOR (BOOSTS TOWERS NEAR IT). EACH UPGRADES ONCE MORE.
KEEP BUILDING WHILE THE WAVES WALK: THEY RE-ROUTE LIVE. SELLING GIVES THREE QUARTERS BACK.
EVERY CREEP FROM YOUR LANE PAYS YOU GOLD WHEN IT DIES, WHOEVER KILLS IT. EVERY WAVE PAYS EVERYONE, PLUS INTEREST ON GOLD YOU'VE SAVED. TIP TEAMMATES WHO NEED IT.
THE TEAM SHARES 20 LIVES (10 MORE FOR EACH LANE PAST THE FIRST). A BOSS EVERY 10 WAVES COSTS 5 IF IT GETS THROUGH. FLYERS GO STRAIGHT OVER THE MAZE; INVISIBLE ONES NEED AN ORACLE.
